source_note: 数据来自开源客户端 Mod SkyHanni 的 SkyHanni-REPO 仓库 constants/regexesModern.json (用于解析游戏内文本的正则表达式常量),已去除正则语法/颜色码还原成干净模板文本, 可信度高于 Wiki 摘要,但未逐条在游戏内截图核对,verified_ingame 仍为 false。

messages.raw: §fI control this lift here behind me.
messages.text: I control this lift here behind me.
messages.zh: 我身后这台升降梯归我管。

messages.raw: §fOnce you've explored an area I can give you a safe ride back there.
messages.text: Once you've explored an area I can give you a safe ride back there.
messages.zh: 只要你去过某个区域,我就能安全地把你送回那儿。

messages.raw: §fBe careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down!
messages.text: Be careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down!
messages.zh: 不过千万小心别掉进井里,下面深着呢!

messages.context: 深层洞窟向导(Lift Menu)尚未解锁时,和 Lift Operator 对话得到的提示
messages.text: Venture down into the Lapis Quarry to unlock my Lift Menu!
messages.zh: 去青金石采石场探险,解锁我的升降梯菜单吧!
messages.raw: §fVenture down into the Lapis Quarry to unlock my Lift Menu!
§fFor that you require Heart of the Mountain.
messages.text: For that you require Heart of the Mountain.
messages.zh: 要去那儿,你得先有山峦之心。

messages.text: Talk to Rhys, the Dwarven Emissary.
messages.zh: 去找矮人使节 Rhys 谈谈吧。

messages.raw: §fOperating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?
messages.text: Operating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?
messages.zh: 整天开这台升降梯,可真够累人的,你知道吧?

messages.text: Back to the mines I go...
